description: Repository static checks. Three independent signals, one owner. Keys use the schema backend/tools/ci/run_checks.py actually reads (check_id / command / timeout_seconds / mandatory) — an earlier version of this file used id/argv/required, which the runner rejects, so it could never have executed. Command paths are relative to backend/, the runner's working directory (ci.yml sets `working-directory: backend`), which is why each script path is prefixed with `../`; the runner spawns commands with no cwd override, so a repo-root-relative path resolved to nothing and every check exited 127 (`bash: no such file`) in 0.00s. Each script then re-anchors itself on `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, so only the argv path needs the prefix.
